changeSet.author: stornuage
changeSet.comment: Rename prediction-tracking columns for clarity. nutritionmeter's "prediction" state is specifically the enrichment outcome (user correction + nutrition computation), not the raw IP-service prediction (which lives in integration.container_registry). The pending-telemetry columns are kept — they back a separate user-correction saga owned by nutritionmeter (TelemetryProcessingService.stashPendingTelemetry → CorrectionService.apply).
